label: Entity extraction
intent: An entity is pulled out of the text and the text closes behind it. Light: the entity pill pops up out of its line, overshoots and settles above it, and as it clears, the two halves of the line snap shut with a hit. Strong: the pill sticks for a moment (a tug down), then pops out higher, swells as it drops back onto its place above the text and settles with two swings; the line halves snap shut, rebound and snap again. Ends with the pill above the closed line.

l1a.//: the line halves either side of the entity; they close the gap it leaves

pill.//: overshoots stop 1.4 inside the top edge at Bold; the Strong swell comes at the low point of the settle
